notes.title: Patch Notes v1.03
notes.content:
This is a minor patch, resolving some rare but pesky bugs:


 Fixed a bug where the game would register phantom controller inputs
 Repositioned some rogue push-pins
 Fixed a rare bug where exiting just before the end credits would soft-lock the game
 Fixed a UI bug where options in the settings menu wouldn't appear at certain resolutions

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.02
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Just another quick patch for some ongoing issues:


 Added an option to turn off the letterbox effect
 Fixed a bug in the settings menu which could lead to the resolution scaling down automatically
 Fixed a rare bug which could soft-lock the final sequence of the game

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is just a quick patch fixing a couple of issues that people ran into:


 Fixed a bug where loading the game would sometimes make twine get stuck to the corkboard
 Prevented the game from picking up irrelevant joystick inputs
 Reduced mouse-stutter from Anti-Aliasing (and also added a tooltip about mouse stutter in the settings menu)
 Fixed an issue with quality settings on Linux builds
